name: TOWA Corporation
summary: TOWA Corporation engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and high-precision molds in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment, Medical Device, and Laser Processing Equipment. The Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment segment manufactures and sells precision molds for semiconductor manufacturing, molding equipment, singulation equipment, etc.; and provides aftersale services. The Medical Device segment manufactures and sells medical devices and other products.
